overview: The board held the crude sketch and three margin words: his father, canvas and paste, and light. You did not copy the waking speech onto this leaf. You did not start the queen. The cat was already off it.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Checked the margin and left the other leaf in the pile.
